cards.backContent: Sociable — hòa đồng, thích giao tiếp
cards.example: I'm quite sociable and I enjoy meeting new people.
I'm diligent and I always try to finish my work on time.

cards.backContent: Innovative — sáng tạo, có ý tưởng mới
cards.example: I'm creative and I like coming up with new ideas.

cards.backContent: Accountable — có trách nhiệm, chịu trách nhiệm
cards.example: I'm responsible and I always try to keep my promises.

cards.backContent: Self-reliant — tự lập, có khả năng tự lo cho mình
cards.example: I'm quite self-reliant and I can solve many problems by myself.
I'm honest and I always try to tell the truth.
I'm a little timid when I meet new people.
I'm humorous and I like making my friends laugh.

cards.backContent: Supportive — hay giúp đỡ, biết hỗ trợ người khác
cards.example: I'm supportive and I like helping my friends when they need me.

cards.backContent: Tolerant — kiên nhẫn, biết chấp nhận sự khác biệt
cards.example: I'm patient and I don't get angry easily.
